report_title: # P0025 ARC12 Hidden-Zero Stream Development-40 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive development packet measures one bounded P0025 correction on P0023's immutable fifth disjoint 20 ARC-AGI-1 plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 filename-only cohort. The P0024 anti-diagonal stream relation previously required its background to be uniquely modal in every input. P0025 instead learns one background color exclusively from the unique modal color of every visible training output, requires that color to occur in every corresponding visible training input, requires unanimous demonstrations, and binds it into the generic hypothesis before it receives a test input. It then dynamically computes the square side from row width times the count of cells unequal to that learned background and paints each non-background visible color along its corresponding anti-diagonal. It refuses absent backgrounds, inconsistent output backgrounds, non-row inputs, empty streams, and oversized grids. P0024's immutable 6/40 source-pinned result is the same-cohort pre-change denominator. The P0024 post-answer failure report motivated this correction, so P0025 is explicitly post-hoc development evidence only, not independent transfer evidence and not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim. The live controller receives only visible training input/output examples and test inputs. It receives no task ID, imported cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or held-out output before committing a complete grid. P0023 and P0024 baseline bytes and reports remain immutable; P0025 results cannot retune this frozen controller or its operator vocabulary.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: A post-P0024 offline-only audit distinguished an input-mode assumption from the visible training-output background relation. P0025 uses no GT feature record or GT solver in the controller. The P0024 post-answer development target was inspected during this R&D diagnosis; therefore P0025 is not an independent result.
